description: Test NoSQL operator injection ($ne, $gt, $regex) for authentication bypass. Sends payloads that abuse MongoDB query operators to bypass password checks. E.g., {"username":"admin","password":{"$ne":""}} matches any non-empty password. Returns: {results: [{payload_name, status, length, likely_bypass, snippet}]}. Side effects: Sends POST requests to the login endpoint. May create sessions.

target_username.description: Username to bypass auth for, e.g. 'admin'

url.description: Login endpoint URL, e.g. https://target/login or https://target/api/auth

username_param.description: JSON field name for username, e.g. 'username' or 'email'

name: nosqli_auth_bypass
